name: flash-attention-from-scratch
primer:
Conventions: single-head, no batch. Q (N,d), K (M,d), V (M,d), output O (N,d); scores S (N,M);
per-row stats m, l, L, D are shape (N,). `scale` is the scalar the caller passes (1/sqrt(d)).
The flash forward tiles over key/value blocks and keeps an UNNORMALIZED running output that is
divided by the running denominator l only at the end.
Every other function in this project is also available in your namespace at grade
time — call earlier steps by name; you do not import them. Run
`uv run python projects.py flash-attention-from-scratch` (or the outline drawer) to see all signatures.
title: Build Flash Attention from Scratch

parts.title: Standard Attention
parts.description: The baseline we optimize: scaled dot-product scores, a numerically stable row softmax, and full materialized attention.

parts.title: Online Softmax
parts.description: The streaming-softmax core: a running max + running denominator that fold one key/value block into the result without ever seeing all scores at once.

parts.title: Flash Forward (Tiled)
parts.description: Tile over key/value blocks, run the online-softmax update per block, normalize, and save the log-sum-exp — exact attention with O(N) extra memory.

parts.title: Causal Flash Attention
parts.description: Mask future keys per block and tile a causal (autoregressive) attention that matches a masked reference.

parts.title: Flash Backward (Recomputation)
parts.description: The backward pass that recomputes the softmax from the saved log-sum-exp instead of storing the N x M probabilities.

steps.name: attention_scores
steps.doc: Compute the scaled dot-product attention score matrix S (N, M).

steps.name: stable_rowmax
steps.doc: Return the per-row maximum of S over the last (keys) axis.

steps.name: softmax_rows
steps.doc: Compute a numerically stable row-wise softmax of S.

steps.name: attention_reference
steps.doc: Compute ground-truth attention: row-softmax of scaled scores applied to V.

steps.name: correction
steps.doc: Rescaling factor exp(m_old - m_new) for old stats when the running max grows (m_old=-inf -> 0).

steps.name: update_running_max
steps.doc: Elementwise running maximum of the previous max and the new block's row max.

steps.name: block_exp_scores
steps.doc: Unnormalized block probabilities: exp of the block scores shifted by the new running max.

steps.name: update_normalizer
steps.doc: Updated softmax denominator: rescaled old denominator plus the new block's exp-score row sums.

steps.name: online_softmax_step
steps.doc:
One fused flash step folding a key/value block into the running (max, denominator, unnormalized output).

Return (m_new, l_new, O_new) in that order, where m_new=update_running_max(m_prev, stable_rowmax(S_block)), p=block_exp_scores(S_block, m_new), l_new=update_normalizer(l_prev, m_prev, m_new, p), and O_new = correction(m_prev, m_new)[:,None]*O_prev + p @ V_block. The old output accumulator O_prev is rescaled by the SAME correction factor as l before adding the new block.

steps.name: make_blocks
steps.doc: Contiguous (start, end) index ranges that tile 0..n; the last may be shorter.

steps.name: finalize
steps.doc: Normalize the unnormalized output accumulator by the running denominator.

steps.name: logsumexp
steps.doc: Per-row log-sum-exp recovered from the running max and denominator.

steps.name: flash_attention_forward
steps.doc: Exact attention by tiling over key/value blocks; return output and saved log-sum-exp.

steps.name: causal_block_mask
steps.doc: Return a copy of S_block with entries whose absolute key index exceeds the absolute query index set to -inf.

steps.name: masked_attention_reference
steps.doc: Compute full causal self-attention by masking future keys, softmaxing each row, and weighting V.

steps.name: flash_attention_causal
steps.doc:
Compute causal self-attention by tiling over key blocks, masking future keys per block before each online-softmax step.

Return O ONLY — the finalized (N, d) output. Unlike flash_attention_forward, do NOT also return L. Tile over key blocks (q_start=0, k_start=ks) and mask each S_block with causal_block_mask before online_softmax_step.

steps.name: attention_backward_D
steps.doc: Per-row dot product of the upstream gradient and the attention output.

steps.name: flash_attention_backward
steps.signature: flash_attention_backward(Q, K, V, O, dO, L, scale)
steps.doc:
Gradients dQ, dK, dV, recomputing the softmax from the saved log-sum-exp instead of storing it.

Return (dQ, dK, dV). Recompute S=attention_scores(Q,K,scale); P=exp(S - L[:,None]) (P is the normalized softmax, since L is the full log-sum-exp); D=attention_backward_D(dO,O); then dV=P.T@dO, dP=dO@V.T, dS=P*(dP - D[:,None]), dQ=scale*(dS@K), dK=scale*(dS.T@Q). Shapes: dQ (N,d), dK (M,d), dV (M,d).
